blockbuilder.visual_critic_note: Deliberately restrained monochromatic palette (#4477AA throughout), smart multi-panel crossfilter layout filling the full viewport, and the color usage scatter plot is genuinely clever — but typography is flat (system-ui, similar weights everywhere) and the dense color panel dots read as noise at small sizes.
blockbuilder.encoding_integrity_note: Correct scaleSqrt for both size channels (network nodes and color dots), zero-based timeline y-axis with data-driven domain, HCL axes use natural fixed domains (0–360 hue, 0–100 lightness) rather than deceptive magic numbers, and no dual-axis or radius-deception issues; minor robustness note: filtered fg bars reuse original y-scale intentionally for context comparison but no encoding violations found.
flags: Update Storm - bitFilter.set() iterates all 34k blocks on every brush mousemove event; only rendering is RAF-throttled, not the O(n) data computation
Stale Closure - xScale/yScale captured in brush closures with no resize handler; scales go stale on window resize
blockbuilder.stress_test_note: RAF dirty-flag pattern correctly throttles DOM rendering and pointer events are unified, but synchronous O(n) bitFilter recomputation inside unthrottled brush handlers will cause jank at 60fps on 34k-block datasets.
blockbuilder.cognitive_load_note: Four linked crossfilter views with clean monochromatic styling and logical grouping keep working memory load manageable, but the 60-node force layout and dense HCL color scatter both sit near perceptual warning thresholds simultaneously.
